solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Dances quietly, held by leader mostly

indicators.note: something held by another sits inside its grip, so one piece goes within the other
mostly means not quite all of the word, so its final letter is dropped

blocks.note: a leader is the boss
p (piano) is the musical marking for quietly

explanation.surface: Someone dances softly while their boss holds them.
explanation.walkthrough: BOSS loses its last S to make BOS, which then wraps round P.
explanation.definitionFit: To bop is to dance informally to pop music, so bops is a third-person verb matching dances.

clue.text: Rail most of all, being stuck in vehicle traffic

indicators.note: most of a word means all but its final letter is kept
something stuck in another is lodged inside it, so one piece sits within the other

blocks.note: a bus is a vehicle
taken as written, then shortened
traffic as a noun means trade or dealing

explanation.surface: A complaint that nearly everyone is stuck in a bus in heavy traffic.
explanation.walkthrough: 'most of all' looks like a superlative phrase, but it means the word all minus its last letter; traffic is a noun meaning commerce.
explanation.definitionFit: A balustrade is a railing supported by a row of small posts, as along a balcony or staircase.

clue.text: Exploited don keeps ahead

indicators.note: to keep something is to hold it within, so one piece goes inside the other

blocks.note: to don clothes is to put them on
ahead, as in a score, is up

explanation.surface: A university lecturer who was exploited still stays in front.
explanation.walkthrough: 'don' reads as a university teacher, but it is the verb meaning to put on clothing.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone put-upon is taken advantage of or imposed on by others, which is to be exploited.

clue.text: Party-pooper left after presentation of prizes

indicators.note: after places the first-named piece behind the following one in the answer

blocks.note: spoils are prizes or loot, here as handed out
port is the left-hand side of a ship

explanation.surface: Someone who ruins the fun by walking out after the prize-giving.
explanation.definitionFit: A spoilsport is someone who ruins others' enjoyment, the same idea as the slang party-pooper.

clue.text: Servant receiving a payment in background

indicators.note: a person receiving something takes it in, so one piece goes inside the other

blocks.note: a page is a young servant
taken as written
rent is a regular payment

explanation.surface: A servant being paid in the background of a scene.
explanation.definitionFit: Parentage is a person's ancestry or origins, which is their family background.

clue.text: Angry thief quietly put away

indicators.note: putting something away removes it from view, so that letter is taken out

blocks.note: a pirate is a thief at sea
p (piano) is the musical marking for quietly

explanation.surface: An angry thief is quietly locked up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'put away' looks like jailing the thief, but it means removing the P.
explanation.definitionFit: Irate is a direct synonym of angry, describing someone furious or incensed.

clue.text: Giver of opinions, one no good interrupting trustworthy bosses?

indicators.note: something interrupting breaks into the middle, so those pieces sit between the others

blocks.note: sound means reliable
I is the Roman numeral one
NG is the abbreviation for no good
the board of directors runs a company

explanation.surface: A useless person butting into a meeting of reliable managers.
explanation.definitionFit: A sounding board is a person used to test ideas on, who gives a response or opinion on them.

clue.text: Finished short musical composition, certainly not before time

indicators.note: short means cut off, so the final letter of the piece is lost

blocks.note: over means finished
a duet is a piece for two performers

explanation.surface: A short duet has ended, and none too soon.
explanation.definitionFit: Overdue means late, coming after the expected time, so it is certainly not early.

clue.text: Drunk turning up around end of party flirts

indicators.note: in a down clue turning up means read from the bottom upwards, so the word is backwards
end of picks out just the final letter of the word that follows
around means surrounding, so one piece wraps the other

blocks.note: a sot is a drunkard
the last letter of party

explanation.surface: A drunk arrives late at a party and flirts.
explanation.definitionFit: To toy with someone is to trifle or flirt with them, so toys is a verb matching flirts.

clue.text: Reformer to pardon gangster after turnaround

indicators.note: a turnaround faces the other way, so the combined letters are read backwards

blocks.note: to remit a sin or penalty is to pardon it
Al Capone is the archetypal gangster

explanation.surface: A reformed character pardons a gangster who has turned his life around.
explanation.walkthrough: Hugh Latimer was a Protestant bishop and English Reformation martyr, burned in 1555.
explanation.definitionFit: Latimer was a leading figure of the English Reformation, so he is a reformer in the religious sense.

clue.text: What's exciting to money-maker — embracing Conservative financial system

indicators.note: something exciting stirs things up, so these letters are thrown into a new order
embracing means holding in the arms, so the shuffled letters wrap around another piece

blocks.note: the letters to be rearranged
C is the abbreviation for Conservative

explanation.surface: What thrills a profiteer is a Tory-led financial system.
explanation.definitionFit: A market economy is an economic system in which prices are set by free supply and demand.

clue.text: An injury, see, to display with sensitivity

blocks.note: an is the article a
a cut is an injury
Ely is a cathedral city, the seat of a bishop's see

explanation.surface: Someone shows an injury and is sensitive about it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'see' looks like a verb, but a see is a bishop's diocese; Ely in Cambridgeshire is a favourite one.
explanation.definitionFit: Acutely means keenly or intensely, as in acutely aware, describing heightened sensitivity.

clue.text: Wonderful person expecting to get married and looked after

blocks.note: super means wonderful
one's intended is one's fiancé or fiancée

explanation.surface: A lovely fiancée who has been cared for.
explanation.definitionFit: To superintend is to oversee or manage, so superintended means supervised or looked after.

clue.text: The misled daren't ask about king "in the altogether"

indicators.note: misled means led astray, so these letters wander out of their order
about means surrounding, so the shuffled letters go round another piece

blocks.note: the letters to be rearranged
K is the chess abbreviation for king

explanation.surface: Duped courtiers dare not tell the king he is naked, as in The Emperor's New Clothes.
explanation.definitionFit: In the altogether is an idiom for nude, so it means completely without clothes.

clue.text: Artist born to be prominent Indian

blocks.note: RA is a Royal Academician
née, used before a maiden name, means born

explanation.surface: An artist born into a family destined for fame in India.
explanation.definitionFit: A ranee (rani) is a Hindu queen or a raja's wife, a woman of high rank in India.

clue.text: A function with navy fellows — time for dressing up

blocks.note: taken as written
a do is a party or social function
RN is the Royal Navy
fellows are men
T is the abbreviation for time

explanation.surface: Sailors heading to a formal party, and it is time to get dressed up.
explanation.definitionFit: Adornment is decoration or embellishment, the act of dressing something up.

clue.text: At a precise moment when hand is fully raised?

definitions.text: At a precise moment when hand is fully raised?

blocks.note: surface reading: a raised hand, as in class or a vote
setter's reading: the minute hand of a clock pointing straight up to twelve

explanation.walkthrough: The minute hand points straight up exactly when a new hour begins.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means exactly at a whole hour such as three o'clock, a precise moment in time.

clue.text: Reduction of dimple maybe with cosmetic filler

indicators.note: a filler is packed into a gap, so one piece fills the middle of the other

blocks.note: a dimple is an example of a dent
a crème is a cosmetic cream

explanation.surface: Using cosmetic filler to reduce a dimple.
explanation.definitionFit: A decrement is a decrease in amount, the opposite of an increment, so it is a reduction.

clue.text: Composer's scheme — nonsense written about it

indicators.note: written about means set down around it, so one piece encloses the other

blocks.note: cod, as in codswallop, is nonsense or a hoax
a plan is a scheme

explanation.surface: A critic dismisses a composer's plan as rubbish.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's stands for 'is', linking the composer to the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: Aaron Copland was an American composer, known for Appalachian Spring and Fanfare for the Common Man.

clue.text: Show deference meeting monarch in enclosure

blocks.note: to bow is to show respect
ER is Elizabeth Regina, the Queen

explanation.surface: Bowing on meeting the Queen in a royal enclosure.
explanation.definitionFit: A bower is a shady leafy shelter or arbour in a garden, an enclosed retreat.

clue.text: Wife ill and crying

blocks.note: W is the abbreviation for wife
ailing means unwell

explanation.surface: A wife who is sick and in tears.
explanation.definitionFit: Wailing is loud crying or lamenting, a synonym for weeping aloud in grief.

clue.text: In favour of career measure bringing rapid development

blocks.note: pro means for
a career is one's working life
a ration is a measured allowance

explanation.surface: Backing a policy of career rationing that leads to fast growth.
explanation.definitionFit: Proliferation is rapid increase or spread, such as quick multiplication of cells or weapons.

clue.text: Run down to follow trendy pop genre

indicators.note: to follow places this piece behind the next one named in the answer

blocks.note: in means fashionable
a battery or clock that runs down will die

explanation.surface: A trendy pop style that soon goes out of fashion.
explanation.definitionFit: Indie is guitar-based pop or rock originally issued by independent record labels, a musical genre.

clue.text: Change when course of events goes the wrong way

indicators.note: going the wrong way means heading backwards, so the word is read in reverse

blocks.note: the tide of events is their general course

explanation.surface: Things alter when events take a bad turn.
explanation.definitionFit: To edit is to revise or alter text, so it is a verb for change.

clue.text: Area on sports field that is very hard

blocks.note: first meaning: the infield of a baseball pitch
second meaning: the hardest natural substance, used as an adjective

explanation.walkthrough: Diamond-hard is a common phrase; the baseball infield is shaped like a diamond.
explanation.definitionFit: Baseball's infield is the diamond, and the gemstone is the hardest known mineral, so it suggests extreme hardness.

clue.text: Devil showing familiar blemish

blocks.note: old as in an old friend, long known
a nick is a small cut or mark

explanation.surface: The devil revealed by a well-known mark.
explanation.definitionFit: Old Nick is a traditional nickname for Satan, the Devil.

clue.text: Day with bed rest organised with companions between the sheets?

indicators.note: organised means arranged into order, so these letters are set out afresh

blocks.note: the letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: A day of planned bed rest, with someone to keep you company in bed.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags that the bedmates are toys, not lovers; 'with' links, and is not part of the letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Teddy bears are soft toys children take to bed, so they keep them company between the sheets.

clue.text: Saw retreats, letting out a mild oath

indicators.note: something that retreats goes backwards, so the word is read in reverse
letting something out releases it, so that letter leaves the word

blocks.note: a saw is an old saying, an adage
the letter A, taken as written

explanation.surface: A saw is withdrawn, letting out a mild curse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Saw' looks like the tool or past tense of see, but here it is a proverb.
explanation.definitionFit: Egad is an old-fashioned exclamation, a mild oath from 'ah God'.
